reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 20. Nay or No: 19. Not Voting: 0. Present or other: 1. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

The press conference with DHS Secretary Mullin and Transportation Secretary Duffy left more questions than answers. Rather than address the American public on a critical matter, they chose to flatter and praise a president who deserves no such recognition. 

As such, I call for https://t.co/TJ257oVfb2

My staff and I are closely monitoring developments related to the ongoing FAA ground stop and will provide updates as they become available. Throughout this situation, safety and reliable air travel is paramount. 

I appreciate the FAA, air traffic controllers, airline personnel, and airport workers who are responding to this incident under challenging circumstances. Anyone who is traveling should check with their respective  airline to receive information on the status of their flight.

https://t.co/4hVs0eSCu9

Congratulations to Rolling Thunder Ohio Chapter 2 on being named Summit County’s 2026 Veteran of the Year and our Champion of the Week for #OH13!

From keeping the POW/MIA mission alive to supporting local veterans, this organization works year-round to honor those who served and https://t.co/IM6EU7I3Qi

I joined the @Labor_Caucus and @AFLCIO to unveil the Pro-Worker Path Forward, an agenda that rewards workers and puts people over profits. I’m fighting every day in Congress for higher wages, safer working conditions, and better benefits for all workers. https://t.co/5qvHpMRIJx

I signed the discharge petition for the Major Richard Star Act because it is our duty to care for those who put their lives on the line for us. 

This bill would provide full benefits to combat-disabled veterans with fewer than 20 years of service. This would allow an additional 50,000 veterans to receive full benefits from the VA.

This Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who have served our nation and defended the freedoms we hold dear. Their courage, sacrifice, and dedication have helped shape our country and strengthened our communities. 

To our veterans and their families, thank you for your service and for the sacrifices you have made. We are forever grateful.

My team and I are here to help. Whether you need help with the IRS, an immigration case, or Social Security, we are here to ensure the government works for you. Reach out at https://t.co/0t1bVObl0G. https://t.co/h6lAC6OALa

I was excited to join METRO to open its new $60 million maintenance and operations facility in Akron! Made possible in part by a $37.8 million federal grant through the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, this investment will help keep buses safe and reliable, support good jobs, and connect Summit County residents to greater opportunities. 

Thank you to the METRO team and everyone who helped turn this vision into reality. This is what investing in Akron and Northeast Ohio looks like!

Due to technical difficulties, our newsletter could not go out on Friday as usual. Stay tuned for our newsletter this week.

If you are not already subscribed, visit https://t.co/0t1bVObl0G! https://t.co/lGWRoqs8Dh

Ohio is home to world-class researchers, and today I’m proud to announce $21.1 million from the National Institute on Aging at the NIH for the Cleveland Alzheimer’s Disease Research Center. This five-year award will help researchers understand why dementia progresses differently for different people.

I’m grateful to the researchers and the volunteer participants who make this work possible! #MoneyMonday

I visited the Canal Fulton-Lawrence Township Fire Department to celebrate the $33,700 federal grant for new fire hoses and an augmented-reality fire extinguisher training system. 

I’m proud to have advocated for funding for these important projects. Thank you, Chief Yerian and https://t.co/kQXe3gXlhb

Law enforcement officials are trusted members of our communities, and that trust must never be abused.

I introduced legislation to curb the misuse of Flock cameras and similar tools by law enforcement officers to stalk victims without their knowledge. Victims whose safety has been put in jeopardy by rogue officers deserve protection, and departments must hold those responsible accountable for their actions.
It is my greatest joy and the honor of a lifetime to serve #OH13 as a Member of Congress. Thank you. https://t.co/iJB8qk54Lr
Today is Election Day! Polls are open from 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. Find your polling location at https://t.co/KRryrrxtDg. https://t.co/Nud2yE7C4x

🎃 Trick or treat! Wishing everyone in #OH13 a safe, spooky, and fun Halloween. Hope your night is filled with good costumes, delicious candy, and maybe just a little bit of fright. 👻 https://t.co/RVtxVPQsEA

Check out Akron’s newest addition! This beautiful sculpture is the work of internationally renowned artist Chakaia Booker and is a testament to the beauty and strength of our community. https://t.co/b3joEzW1bs
Thanks to Republicans, this Halloween is spooky for all the wrong reasons. https://t.co/syPqdXKK6J

I was proud to tour the Twinsburg Army Reserve Center and meet with the dedicated service members who work hard every day to support our national defense and serve our communities

Thank you to the men and women of the Army Reserve for your commitment, professionalism, and https://t.co/tJ0gNoCVAs

Every person deserves to live free from fear and violence. I’m committed to standing with survivors and delivering real solutions that help them rebuild their lives.

During Domestic Violence Awareness Month, we honor the courage of survivors and highlight the urgent need for stronger protections. The bills I’ve led reflect our promise to create safer communities where every person can heal, thrive, and live with dignity.

I joined the Domestic Violence Project, Inc. for Take Back the Night in Canton. During Domestic Violence Awareness Month, I’m honoring the courage of the survivors who are sharing their stories, and thanking DVPI and its partner agencies for the work they do every day to keep Stark County families safe.

Survivors deserve safety, housing, and support. I will keep fighting to bring home federal resources, and to pass the reauthorization of Violence Against Women Act and the bills I’ve introduced to protect survivors.

If you or someone you know needs help, DVPI’s 24-hour crisis line is available any time. Call or text the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233.

Law enforcement officials are trusted members of our communities. Abuse of Flock cameras and similar tools by law enforcement officers to stalk victims without their knowledge will not be tolerated.

I introduced the Law Enforcement Accountability for Plate Reader Abuse (LEAP) Act to protect victims whose safety has been put in jeopardy by rogue officers and to ensure that departments are holding those responsible accountable for their actions.

📣 Medicare Open Enrollment is here!

If you have Medicare, now is the time to review your coverage and make sure your plan still meets your needs. You can compare plans, explore your options, and find coverage that works best for you.

Medicare decisions matter, and having the right information can make all the difference. I encourage everyone eligible to take advantage of this opportunity to review their options before the enrollment deadline.

For more information, visit https://t.co/l7QldgghO0 or call 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227).

I hosted the 2nd Women in Leadership Conference and a time was had! Thank you to everyone who showed up, participated in important conversations, and plotted the path to changing our communities for the better through more women in leadership. https://t.co/zllQ4PBrIv
Don’t forget! Today is the last day to submit for the 2026 Congressional App Challenge. Learn more at https://t.co/0t1bVOaNb8. https://t.co/NWiu6kqwut

Congratulations to Akron’s Dragon Dream Team, Ohio’s first and only breast cancer survivor dragon boat team, on being named Ohio’s 13th Congressional District’s Champion of the Week!

The team recently represented Northeast Ohio at the 2026 International Breast Cancer Paddlers’ Commission Participatory Dragon Boat Festival in France, where its Dream crew earned second place overall in the world in the 1,000-meter race and finished first among all U.S. teams!

Join Team Sykes! Our D.C. and District offices are looking for interns for the 2027 Spring Semester. This is your chance to serve Ohio’s 13th District and gain hands-on experience in public service.  

The D.C. office application deadline is November 6th. The District office is accepting applications on a rolling basis.

I toured Cleveland Clinic Mercy in Canton and joined a roundtable with Susan G. Komen, doctors, and patient advocates to talk about how we can get more Ohioans timely breast cancer screening and diagnosis. Thank you to Dr. Elizabeth Russ, Dr. Megan Kruse, and the patient https://t.co/CqEv4Y6vV8

My team has helped many individuals just like Debby cut through red tape to get nearly $15 million in tax returns that were being held up by the IRS. If you need help with the IRS, or any federal agency, contact my office today at 330-400-5350. #WeWorkForYou https://t.co/Ey7EhsOoyx

Proud to join the Green Harvest Capital as The Standard on Main becomes Vine on Main. This is a local company investing in downtown Akron, and it’s bringing affordable housing close to hospitals, employers, and the University of Akron.

Vibrant downtowns and affordable housing go https://t.co/lZva6iNWxA
Ohioans can’t afford Republican policies that drive up costs, all while putting more money in the pockets of billionaires. https://t.co/SLI0vt7XUz

I’m still thinking about the 2nd Women in Leadership Conference at the Akron Art Museum!

More than 200 women came together to share ideas, build connections, and lift each other up. Between the conversations on stage and the ones that happened over lunch, I keep coming back to https://t.co/yzaaW1RtCt

I joined business, community, and government leaders at the Greater Stark County Urban League for a candid conversation about what keeps people from entering and staying in the workforce. Transportation, housing, childcare, and affordability are real barriers, and I’m committed to working with local partners to support people aspiring to enter the workforce.

Thank you to the entire Urban League team for convening this conversation and for more than a century of service to Stark County. I’m glad to support the SOAR initiative and look forward to being a partner.

Calling all middle and high school students in Ohio’s 13th District! The Congressional App Challenge is open, and it’s your chance to turn a great idea into a real app.

Think of an idea. Write the code. Submit your app.

Submissions are due October 26th, 2026. Register today at https://t.co/UiYYt6DuUG.

Congratulations to the Summit Education Initiative on 30 years of impact! For three decades, SEI has used data and partnerships to support students in Summit County from cradle to career. 

I’m grateful to Dr. David James, County Executive Ilene Shapiro, Mayor Shammas Malik, and everyone who has helped make this work possible.

When our students succeed, our workforce, our economy, and our communities grow stronger. I’m proud to celebrate this milestone and look forward to what’s next.

Join Team Sykes! Our D.C. and District offices are looking for interns for the 2027 Spring Semester. This is your chance to serve Ohio’s 13th District and gain hands-on experience in public service.

The D.C. office application deadline is November 6th. The District office is accepting applications on a rolling basis.

Apply at https://t.co/ufyEaYTE84.

More than 137,000 Ohioans, including 60,000 children, have lost SNAP benefits since President Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill took effect. Families deserve a president focused on lowering costs, not making it harder to eat. https://t.co/hRwwV1empT

October is LGBTQ+ History Month.

This month is a chance to honor the people who fought, organized, and risked everything so that others could live openly and authentically. Their history is American history, and it deserves to be told and taught.
To my LGBTQ+ neighbors in Ohio's 13th District: you belong here, and you make our communities stronger. I'll keep fighting for a country where everyone is treated with dignity and has the freedom to be who they are.

posts.text:
Today we celebrate Indigenous Peoples' Day.

Native peoples have lived on, cared for, and shaped the land we now call Ohio for thousands of years. Their history, cultures, and contributions are part of our story, and they deserve to be honored, taught, and remembered, not just today but all year.

I'm grateful for the Native communities who continue to carry their traditions forward and enrich our state. Today is a chance to learn, listen, and reflect on that legacy together.

Today is World Mental Health Day.

Taking care of our mental health is just as important as taking care of our physical health, and no one should have to face a hard time alone. To everyone in Ohio's 13th District who is struggling, or who is supporting someone who is: you matter, and help is available.

If you or someone you know needs support, call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, any time, day or night. Reaching out is a sign of strength.
Thank you to the counselors, nurses, social workers, and caregivers across our community who show up for their neighbors every day.

Stories have the power to open minds, build empathy, and bring people together. This Banned Books Week, we push back against the extremists seeking to reject the truth and continue the fight to protect the freedom to read, learn, question, and imagine. https://t.co/FxxQ5wfzQG

Big news for Akron! The University of Akron has received a $241,455 grant from the National Eye Institute to study how cells in the retina communicate. Vision research leads to better ways to understand, prevent, and treat eye disease, and it gives students hands-on experience that prepares them for careers in science and medicine. Northeast Ohio is home to researchers asking important questions, and I'm proud to support their work. #MoneyMonday

Calling all student coders in Ohio’s 13th District! The Congressional App Challenge is the official student STEM competition of the U.S. House of Representatives, open to middle and high school students. Any app, any platform, any language. Register at https://t.co/FysHhoaR65 and submit by October 26.

This Breast Cancer Awareness Month, I’m honoring every survivor, every fighter, and every family who has faced this disease. Early detection saves lives, and I'm committed to making sure Ohioans have access to the screenings, treatment, and care they need. https://t.co/WMImfJnRCt

Every survivor deserves the chance to heal, thrive, and live with dignity. This Domestic Violence Awareness Month, I’m continuing to advocate for legislation I've championed to support survivors, from economic independence and trauma-informed healthcare to safe housing and protection from stalking. Swipe through to learn more, and if you or someone you know needs help, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is available 24/7 at 1-800-799-7233.

October is Domestic Violence Awareness Month. To every survivor: you are not alone, and help is available. If you or someone you know needs support, call the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233 or text START to 88788. It is free, confidential, and available 24/7. https://t.co/46sm7MNWum

I'm so excited to bring together some of our community's most inspiring women for my Women in Leadership Conference on October 9th!Come ready to learn, connect, and be inspired. Register now at https://t.co/L3xLjsRU7P https://t.co/LqvRs9PjrV

My team attended the Summit County Farm Bureau's annual meeting, where Dr. Jim Vogt received this year's Distinguished Service Award along with special Congressional recognition for his outstanding contributions. Congratulations, Dr. Vogt! Farmers across Ohio’s 13th District are facing rising costs and real challenges, and I’m fighting in Washington for policy that supports family farms. Learn more about my work: https://t.co/Sfbg4V6egF .

From Ohio’s 13th District to Arizona to Massachusetts to Minnesota, the headlines are the same: SNAP cuts are putting food out of reach for families. I voted against the Republican bill that made these disastrous cuts, and I'm cosponsoring legislation to repeal them. Families shouldn't go hungry in the richest country in the world.

The U.S. lost 15,000 farms in 2025, according to USDA, and Ohio lost about 400 of them. Only the largest operations grew, while small and mid-sized family farms are the ones being squeezed out. I voted against a Republican farm bill that fell short on support for farmers, and I opposed an agriculture funding bill that cut USDA staffing for farmer assistance programs. Our farmers feed us, and they deserve a Congress that fights for them.

94% of farmers say their finances are worse or haven’t improved this year. Trump's trade war has cost farmers their markets and their margins, and I'm pushing back against policies that put politics ahead of family-owned farms. https://t.co/NlOHL5sTkT

On Monday, September 28, the Office of Congresswoman Emilia Sykes will host Congress In Our Community from 12-3 p.m. at the Twinsburg Public Library, located at 10050 Ravenna Rd, Twinsburg, OH 44087 At Congress In Our Community, Team Sykes will be on-hand to provide personalized assistance for a variety of issues with federal agencies. If you need assistance with expediting your passport, the IRS and tax matters, Social Security, Medicaid, Veterans Affairs, or more, our office is here to help. Please note: there will be no formal presentation, nor will Congresswoman Sykes be in attendance – these office hours are one-on-one visits between members of the district staff and constituents. You may stop by anytime during the event.

Happy National Public Lands Day! Cuyahoga Valley National Park is one of Northeast Ohio's greatest treasures, supporting about 2,000 jobs and more than $225 million in economic impact every year. That's why I led a letter calling for full funding for the National Park Service, and why I've fought for federal funding to fix the sewer system in Peninsula, the gateway to the park. Our public lands belong to all of us. Get outside this weekend and enjoy them.

I’m thrilled to have gotten a behind-the-scenes tour of the Canton Palace Theatre as it celebrates 100 years. Thank you to Georgia Paxos and the entire team for preserving this downtown Canton landmark and keeping it a home for film, live performance, and community. https://t.co/SVF50yUcu8

Bankruptcy should never be used to get -out -of  -jail free card when consumers are harmed. I had the opportunity to talk about my bill, Consumer Protection and Corporate Accountability in Bankruptcy Act of 2026, with @11alive . https://t.co/mCRwNzWanm

Yesterday, I had the opportunity to present Massillon Mayor Slutz with a Congressional Bicentennial Commemorative Resolution honoring 200 years of the city's history. From its founding to today, Massillon has been a cornerstone of our district, and it was an honor to celebrate this milestone with Mayor Slutz and the entire community.

I was honored to visit Spring Hill Historic Home in Massillon. During International Underground Railroad Month, it's a powerful reminder of the history in our community. Built in 1821 by Quakers Thomas and Charity Rotch, Spring Hill was a station on the Underground Railroad, where the family hid freedom seekers and helped guide them toward Canada, including a hidden staircase still preserved in the home today.

I'm hosting the Women in Leadership Conference right here in OH-13 on October 9th. Make sure to reserve your spot at https://t.co/0t1bVOaNb8. I look forward to seeing you there! https://t.co/tLd38DzmGx
